messages:
incident-bot: :bell: Alert: Spike in correctness errors for tenant FinEdge on kv-read path (+22% error rate vs baseline). Possible prefix-level staleness. Auto-paging oncall.

oncall-lee: seeing the alert and a support ticket about "billing mismatches". paging eng-cache-rita. @eng-cache-rita can you take?

eng-cache-rita: looking. reproducing bad totals via shadow reads against prefix billing:finedge:*. early hypothesis: prefetch + async write reorder on high-card prefixes -> stale values being served.

support-omar: customer reports bad invoice totals since ~14:03 UTC, intermittent. marking SEV-2. escalating.

eng-lee: telemetry: prefix hit-rate collapsed, store reads increased, and some reads returning older vtags. suspect prefetch eviction race during heavy write bursts.

eng-cache-rita: quick mitigation plan:
- switch off prefetch rules for billing:finedge:* immediately
- enable read-bypass (route reads to primary store) for affected prefix for 45m
- enact soft-per-tenant rate limit to cut noisy retry storms

sre-monica: agree with surgical approach. prefer shard-scoped rollout to avoid global perf hit. do canary on shards 12 and 14 first.

eng-cache-rita: executing carveout. commands for ops API:
```bash
# turn off prefetch for FinEdge prefix
curl -X POST https://ops-api/mitigate -d '{"op":"set_prefetch","prefix":"billing:finedge:*","state":"off","ttl":"45m","user":"eng-cache-rita"}'

# enable read-bypass to primary for that prefix
curl -X POST https://ops-api/mitigate -d '{"op":"prefix_read_bypass","prefix":"billing:finedge:*","ttl":"45m"}'

# apply tenant soft quota
curl -X POST https://ops-api/mitigate -d '{"op":"tenant_limit","tenant":"finedge","read_qps":150}'
```

ops-deploy-bot: mitigation tasks queued: set_prefetch -> assigned region-us -> node-pool-3

eng-cache-rita: prefetch disabled on shards 12/14. starting canary traffic reroute to bypass path.

oncall-lee: can we route the problematic prefix to consistency-lane-2 (stronger consistency, slower) for affected shards while bypass is active?

eng-lee: added routing override: billing:finedge:* -> consistency-lane-2 for 20m. expect +50-120ms on reads but correctness should be restored.

product-lina: notifying account team to send message to FinEdge. include note that we applied emergency mitigations that may slow reads temporarily. support to prepare customer-facing copy.

support-omar: drafting note: "We've applied targeted mitigations to restore correct billing totals. You may see slightly increased latency for reads; we're monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem." Will send after confirming stability.

ops-deploy-bot: prefix_read_bypass applied to shard-12 and shard-14; tenant_limit enforced. mitigation record: mg-45890123-B logged.

eng-cache-rita: monitoring: incorrect-read rate dropping back toward baseline. cache-hit rate for prefix expectedly lower. read p95 up ~80ms on canary shards.

sre-monica: recommend keeping bypass until next maintenance window unless correctness regressions reappear. also capture request traces for sample keys to assist RCA.

oncall-lee: handoff in 25m. handing to night-oncall-nina. nina, please monitor the error-rate and escalate to eng if it climbs above +5% from baseline.

night-oncall-nina: ack. I'll keep watch on dashboards and coordinate with support.

support-omar: customer replied: "Thanks — totals look right now." I'll keep them updated and offer to review logs with them if needed.

eng-cache-rita: creating ticket INF-9872 with notes: root cause likely prefetch gating on high-cardinality prefixes + write-reordering during bursts. action items:
- short: tighten prefetch gating for high-card prefixes; opt-out list for critical tenants
- medium: add read-after-write consistency option for tenant-scoped critical prefixes
- long: add prefix-level correctness synthetic tests in canary and augment telemetry alerts for vtag regressions

sre-monica: also add runbook step to prefer shard-scoped bypass before tenant-global changes.

eng-lee: we've instrumented extra sampling for billing:finedge:* and enabled detailed traces for any read that hits a stale version.

oncall-lee: closing live mitigation. leave mg-45890123-B active until TTL ends or until infra fix deployed. good job team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=SEV-2 -> monitoring. mitigation_id=mg-45890123-B. Thread archived for ops but remains for postmortem and RCA.
